notes: Texas Application for a sales and use tax permit, filled for a business entity with one place of business. Yes/No questions take Yes or No. Phones print as 408-555-0142 and the FEIN as 12-3456789 in the form's own cells; dates print MMDDYYYY in their cells. Items 10-14 are for a sole proprietor and take only the name and FEIN here; the Social Security number boxes (items 9 and 11) are never printed, the signer writes them. Items 30c-30f (agents when there is no Texas place of business), 42 (out-of-state winery), 52 (9-1-1 fees) and the previous owner's title, phone and taxpayer number are left for the signer. The legal name repeats at the top of pages 3 to 5. The date of signature is left for the signer.
